name: Chatty prospect gives full pain in one answer
description: Some prospects over-share. When they hand you people+chaos+money+doctor pain in one go, coach must pick the dominant thread and proceed to pain math or summary — not re-diagnose.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. Skip gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Hi, this is Michelle at Valley Dental.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Michelle, Seb with DentaVoice. Would it be unreasonable if I took two minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah sure. Honestly? We're swamped. Lost a receptionist in February, haven't replaced her because Dr. Chen has us on a tight budget, and I'm basically running the front desk AND doing billing. My Google Ads are getting calls I can't answer half the time and my Thursday schedule looks like Swiss cheese.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: She just gave you people + money + chaos + doctor + revenue in 3 sentences. Coach should either: label/summarize (21 or 24) to consolidate, OR pick the strongest thread (people/chaos). Should NOT keep asking diagnostic questions — enough pain revealed to progress. Thread assignment is subjective here; any single valid thread is acceptable.
